title: The route code and state sit on the case (P3) and the baseline snapshots with rwb-reporting (P9) while only case_list_row is P1's, and no source gives the legacy dump's source or format, the handover locations, the retention period of the legacy tables or where the data steward's sign-off is held
source: Ownership Map v1 recovery_case (P3) and measure_snapshot (P9); context pack P1 ownership rows (Tables (18) include case_list_row); legacy RWB-DM-011 Data table, AC1 and AC3
description: The legacy story migrates recovery_case, case_list_row and measure_snapshot in one P1 cutover step. The Ownership Map splits the three: the case and its route with P3 rwb-case, the measures with P9 rwb-reporting, and the daily case list projection with P1 rwb-source-data, while the case list API and screen stay with P3. The Work Package gives AC1 and AC3 to RWB-P1-DM011-APP and AC2 to RWB-ITG-DM011-ITG. No source says whether the route history of a migrated case is loaded by rwb-case from a handed-over extract, whether the baseline is loaded by rwb-reporting frozen, how the handed-over files reach each owner, how long the legacy tables stay read-only after the sign-off, or which record holds that sign-off.
evidence: Ownership Map recovery_case owner P3, measure_snapshot owner P9, case_list_row owner P1; context pack P1 Tables (18) lists case_list_row and no measure table; legacy RWB-DM-011 Data table rows recovery_case DF-CAS-001 to DF-CAS-055, case_list_row DF-RPT-001 to DF-RPT-019, measure_snapshot DF-RPT-041 to DF-RPT-052; legacy Endpoints: No endpoint in this story; legacy Screen and states: SCR-45 Data quality.
proposed: P1 extracts the legacy case list rows, route facts and baseline snapshots, loads its own case_list_row for the cutover business date, hands the route facts to rwb-case and the baseline snapshots to rwb-reporting as files with checksums, and copies no COLLINS score.
